sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, raw x/y, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/royal-caribbean/grandeur-of-the-seas/v2521/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one .cabinShape[data-cabin] element per stateroom (rect, plus 4 polygons on deck 8). Category legend built by matching each fill colour to Royal Caribbean stateroom categories, verified per-colour against exact category counts from cruisedeckplans.com Grandeur-of-the-Seas stateroom breakdown.

notes.completeness: NEAR-FULL grid: 996 of 997 staterooms. Cabin decks are 2,3,4,7,8 (counts 227/285/153/189/142). Decks 5,6,9,10,11,12 carry no staterooms in the source (public/venue decks). cruisedeckplans.com lists 997 staterooms; deckmaps encodes 996 - exactly one Interior stateroom is absent from the deckmaps SVGs (Interior 399 vs 400). No cabin number was invented to close the gap.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 15 distinct fills map to 9 Royal Caribbean categories (several categories use more than one colour shade). Mapping was pinned by matching parsed per-colour counts to cruisedeckplans.com category totals: Interior 400, Ocean View 380, Spacious/Ocean View Balcony 122, Junior Suite 72, Grand Suite 1-BR 12, Owners Suite 5, Grand Suite 2-BR 4, Royal Suite 1, Oceanview Suite 1. See colorLegend.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Length axis is the SVG y-axis; bow direction detected per deck from cabin numbering (numbers increase forward->aft, so the bow is the low-y end). section = forward/mid/aft thirds of the hull length. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Geometric split of the beam (SVG x-axis) at each deck's mid-line: x below mid = port, x above = starboard, assuming a standard viewed-from-above deck plan with the bow at the low-y end. Vision-class cabin numbering does NOT split cleanly by odd/even, so parity could not confirm the labelling; the port/starboard assignment could be uniformly mirrored. Validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction, not asserted as clear-view).
